**About Revelocity Sports** 




 Revelocity Sports is an innovative startup revolutionizing how minor league sports teams approach sales and marketing. We provide data\-driven, personalized marketing solutions through our proprietary platform that helps teams understand their fans better, deploy omni\-channel marketing campaigns, and ultimately fill more seats. We’re an AI\-forward company through and through — automation and intelligent systems aren’t a side project here, they’re the engine behind our platform, our product roadmap, and how we punch above our weight every day. We’re a small team, which means the engineer we hire will see their work go straight into use, not into a backlog.
 



  





**The Opportunity** 




 We’re looking for an AI Developer to own day\-to\-day development at Revelocity — building the AI automations, data pipelines, and product features that power our platform and open up new product lines and revenue opportunities. You’ll come from an engineering background and be excited about using AI in development workflows and building integrations, automations, and applying AI to real product problems. To be clear: this isn’t a research role — we’re not training models, we’re building with them and building them into products.
 



  





 This role is mostly AI engineering, built on a foundation of data engineering. The two halves feed each other — the data makes the AI possible and useful, and the AI makes the data go further, faster. We’ll shape the day\-to\-day around your strengths, but expect the center of gravity to sit with AI and automation.
 



  





 This isn’t a role where you’ll be stuck doing one thing. You’ll work directly with our founders, touch everything from automation and data engineering to product strategy and see the impact of what you build show up in our clients’ stadiums.
 



  





 This is a full\-time, in\-person role in Cincinnati — you’re local or willing to relocate. That doesn’t mean you can never work remotely, but we’re looking for someone who can spend most of their time in the office with us. We’re hiring for the long term — we want someone who joins to grow with the company, with a clear path toward greater technical ownership and leadership over time.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* **AI and Automation\-Focused Product Development:** 
 Take slow, manual, expensive tasks and turn them into things that run for a few dollars and a few minutes — designing, building, and shipping AI\-powered automations that work nights and weekends, scale our business beyond our headcount, and open up new product lines and revenue opportunities across our RevTM platform and client work — wiring together SaaS tools, internal scripts, and LLM agents
* **Product Development:** 
 Own day\-to\-day development throughput across the whole lifecycle — hear what we’re trying to accomplish, figure out what’s worth building, translate intent into working product, prototype quickly, ship, measure it honestly, and keep it running
* **Data Engineering:** 
 Build and maintain the data pipelines and integrations that power our platform, client campaigns, and reporting — keep the data flowing reliably, extend it to new teams and new data sources; this is the foundation everything else stands on
* **Platform Stewardship:** 
 Learn our existing systems and infrastructure deeply enough to monitor, maintain, and extend them — so critical knowledge never lives with just one person
* **Data Security \& Privacy:** 
 Treat security and privacy as a backstop rolled into everything we build — protecting client and fan data and guarding against the common disasters before they happen
* **Documentation \& Knowledge Sharing:** 
 Document what you build and contribute to our internal knowledge base so the whole team can understand, use, and trust our systems
* **Deliver Against Outcomes:** 
 Work against concrete timelines and tangible deliverables — we measure success by results, not activity
* **Enable Our Team with AI:** 
 Our team uses AI all day, every day. You’ll help everyone use it as efficiently as possible — introducing new agents, models, harnesses, and skills— guided by your sense of where this technology is good, where it falls over,
 
 and how to tell the difference.



  





**What You’ll Build \& Tech You’ll Use** 




 Here are illustrative examples of the kinds of products you'll build and the tools you'll work with — not an exhaustive list, but the spirit of how we approach development problems:
 



  





*Example projects:* 



* AI\-powered internal tools that manage marketing and creative workflows — from campaign drafting to creative production
* Client and project management systems that keep our team and clients aligned without manual overhead
* Lead\-generation pipelines — like our system that finds contact information for thousands of local businesses that off\-the\-shelf tools miss: web scraping feeding carefully designed LLM prompts, with an evaluation harness that scores output against human\-verified ground truth so we know it’s actually working
* Assistants that make our data answerable — letting the team get answers from our warehouse of customers, purchases, and campaigns without writing SQL by hand



  





*Here’s a snapshot of our broader stack and tools today — it will evolve as we grow, and you’ll help shape it:* 



* Python for nearly everything
* Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery
* Claude Code, Claude Design, and Cowork — plus other good\-fit LLMs
* Cursor
* Image generation models
* Hex.tech
* Notion, Meta, Zapier, and GitHub



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 What we genuinely require — this is a short list on purpose. If these three are true, we want to hear from you:
 


* You’re in Cincinnati, or ready to be — local or willing to relocate, and able to spend most of your time in the office with us• You can really write code — real, working programs, ideally in Python, though a strong foundation in another language counts; you can read code you didn’t write, debug it, ship something that works, and you understand coding best practices and common patterns
* You’re comfortable with data — querying it with SQL, moving it around programmatically, testing and analyzing it, and caring deeply about whether the numbers are right
* You have a bias towards quick prototyping and iteration — we’re often balancing speed and quality. Our goal is to build as quickly as possible while maintaining quality, proving substance before scale



  





 Everything below is a head start, not a barrier — we don’t expect any single person to have all of these, and the rest you’ll pick up here:
 


* You’ve built something with an LLM — even a side project, a script that calls an AI API, or a workflow you automated — and you’re curious about where this technology is good, where it falls over, and how to tell the difference
* You’ve built or maintained a data pipeline, an ETL/ELT process, web scraping, or API integrations — wrangling messy real\-world data into clean, usable form
* Product\-oriented — you can hear what we’re trying to accomplish, translate it into product, and figure it out with minimal hand\-holding
* A tech generalist at heart — comfortable picking up new tools and languages, not locked into a single stack
* Hungry — you want to grow, take on more responsibility, and build toward technical leadership
* You’ve worked with cloud infrastructure (GCP, AWS, or Azure), Docker, or scheduled jobs — or you’re comfortable learning your way around them
* You write things down — when you make a decision or find something surprising, you leave a trail so the next person understands it
* You have an interest in sports, marketing, analytics, or how data drives business decisions



  





**Our Core Values** 



1. **Keep Innovating:** 
 We’re restless in the best way — constantly asking “how can this be better?” We leverage technology and AI to punch above our weight, experiment with new approaches, and find smarter, more efficient ways to solve every challenge.
2. **Stay Curious:**

3. **Get Stuff Done:**

4. **Be Relentlessly Helpful:** 
 We show up for our teammates, our clients, and our communities with 110% effort — not because we have to, but because that’s how great work happens. We’re tuned into what others need, actively collaborative, and always willing to jump in.



  





**A Note on Fit** 




 Studies — and our own experience — show that people talk themselves out of applying when they don’t match every line of a job post. Please don’t. If you can write code, you’re comfortable with data, and you’re excited about building AI tools that do real work, we’d genuinely like to talk — even if half the “head start” list is unfamiliar. We’re hiring for trajectory and judgment as much as for what you already know, and we’re set up to help you grow into the rest.

description_preview:
**Work at Blissway: Opportunity for Impact Every Day 🚀✨**
 Blissway is a startup that simplifies toll collection and dramatically improves highway safety. We are multiple startups in one:
 **Deep Tech, AI/ML, Hardware, SaaS, and IoT.** 
 For the past five years, we have built a nearly insurmountable technological lead in tolling, an industry that is quietly bigger than football. While our competitors have thousands of employees, we operate with a lean but growing team of less than 30\. We’ve stayed under the radar, but our impact is visible on the massive Interstate Highway System connecting every major US metro (except Juneau, AK—sorry, Juneau).
   

  

**You are a good fit if...**
* You love the grind: You take ownership and put in the time to meet deadlines. Our recent team survey showed an average of 55 hours/week, with occasional 70\+ hour bursts for major releases.
* You are detail obsessed: You have experience writing code that stands up to the unpredictability of the physical world, where the small details are the difference between success and failure.
* You are adaptable: We are a lean team. If you only want to work on a "niche thing" or are uncomfortable helping other teams when they need a boost, this isn't the place for you. We expect you to figure out what you need to get stuff done.
* You code really well: We mostly use Python and TypeScript, but we don’t care what you’re most proficient in today—as long as you learn fast.


**Software Engineer, Machine Learning Team**
**The Mission:** 
 You are the engineer who ships the model, not just the one who trains it. At Blissway, we process 11 million images every single day, running detection, segmentation, classification, embeddings, and re\-identification across everything in the camera’s frame. You will own the full arc: raw sensor data to production inference, dataset curation to deployment monitoring, cloud to edge. This role is for the engineer who sees a model sitting in a notebook and feels the itch to put it to the test, or in this case, on the road.
   

  

**The Work**
* Own the Whole Pipeline: You decide which problems are worth solving, then take them from raw sensor data all the way to production: collection, dataset curation, training, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. We wire it all together and run our own servers, so the pipeline is yours end to end.
* Real Hardware in the Real World: This is the part that makes us special. We own the devices in the field. This means any idea you have can actually get built and tested on real roads.
* Vision at Real Scale: We process 11 million images every single day, running detection, segmentation, classification, embeddings, and re\-identification across everything in the frame: vehicles, license plates, wheels, even lane markings. Beyond images, we have multiple other sensors on the road pulling in different data making the problem space wide open. At this volume, the right model can drastically improve accuracy and cut cost at the same time.
* Classical CV to Custom SOTA: Our toolbox spans the full range, from traditional computer vision algorithms to custom\-trained state\-of\-the\-art models (detection, segmentation, embeddings, classifiers). You pick the right tool, and when nothing off\-the\-shelf is good enough, you train your own.
* Build the Best Models That Exist: We read the papers, go to the conferences, and hold our work to the current frontier. ML has become essential to Blissway over the past year, and this team is where that bet gets made real.
* Edge and Cloud: Most of our compute lives in the cloud where power is effectively unlimited. We're now pushing more inference onto the roadside hardware itself, a completely different problem: the models have to be fast, small, and power\-efficient without giving up accuracy. You'll work both sides of that constraint.


**Requirements**
* Experience: 2 to 6 years of software engineering with a focus on machine learning and/or computer vision. We want someone with true end\-to\-end experience: you've taken models from raw data to production and owned what happens after they ship.
* Both Sides: Strong software engineering fundamentals plus hands\-on ML. You write production\-quality code and you train and debug models. The two overlap, and we want someone comfortable across both.
* Full Lifecycle: You've owned models beyond the notebook: trained, deployed, monitored, and iterated in production.
* Real CV depth. Experience with modern computer vision and the judgment to know when a classical technique beats a heavy model. You're not reaching for a transformer when a filter will do.


**How We Work**
 We're a small team, which means a more deliberate interview process than you might be used to. In exchange, you get real autonomy from day one, direct access to the people setting technical direction, and work that ships to real roads in weeks, not quarters.
   

  

**The Process:** 
 We hire software engineers in cohorts. Rather than evaluate candidates on a rolling basis, we collect applications over a two\-week window and assess everyone together. This allows us to make fair, considered comparisons and move the strongest candidates through the process efficiently and fairly.
   

  

 The process has five stages:
   

  

* Application Review: We (a human) read every application carefully at the close of the approximately two\-week window.
* Ezra: A brief AI\-assisted screening to make sure we're a mutual fit before investing more of your time. Think of this as a way to augment your application.
* Screening Interview: A focused conversation to understand your background and motivations.
* Technical Interview: A deeper evaluation of your skills and how you think through problems.
* Experience Interview: A conversation about how you've worked and what you've built.
* Final In\-Person: A chance to meet the team and see the work environment firsthand.


 We'll be in touch at the close of the application window with next steps.
   

  

**The Essentials (Health \& Wealth)**
* Relocation Support: We are excited for you to join the team at our engineering office in Denver. We value in\-person collaboration and daily team lunches and we provide a relocation bonus to help you get here.
* Personalized Health Coverage (ICHRA): We don’t believe in one\-size\-fits\-all healthcare. We provide a monthly allowance for you and dependents so you can choose the individual plan that actually fits your life.
* Investing in Your Future: 401(k) matching up to 4%.
* Peace of Mind: Transparent compensation. Company\-sponsored life \& disability insurance.
* Early Stage Equity: Competitive equity package with 24\-month exercise window. Every year, we facilitate a tender process that gives you the opportunity to sell your vested shares at the same valuation as our investors.


**Rest \& Recharge 🌴**
* High\-Trust Time Off: 4 weeks of untracked PTO. We don't micromanage your calendar; we focus on your impact. Take the time you need to stay sharp and inspired.
* Family First: 12 weeks of paid parental leave for birth and adoptive parents. We want you present for the moments that matter most.
* The Deep Breath (Sabbatical): Every 5 years, take 12 weeks of fully paid leave. Go travel, write a book, or master a new hobby—then come back and tell us all about it.


**Fuel \& Community 😀**
* The Blissway Kitchen: Whether it’s breakfast to start your day or our daily group lunches, we keep the team fueled.
* Snacks Autonomy: Our kitchen is fully stocked and we mean it—if we’re missing your favorite fuel, just add it to the request list.
* The "BlissTrip": An annual 3–4 day getaway for the team and significant others.
* Monthly Beats: Game nights, escape rooms, and dinners to celebrate the grit we put in.
* Continuous Learning: Tuition reimbursement for courses, programs, and conferences that sharpen your craft.

 Posted by Sidebar on behalf of Watch Club.

 👋
 **Hi!** 




 My name is Henry! I’m the founder and CEO of Watch Club. Watch Club is a seed stage startup backed by Google Ventures.
 



 We are looking for a full stack engineer who:
 


* is world class at building native iOS apps (swift/swiftui) and capable at building web apps (react) and backend systems.
* loves building 0\-1 consumer products.
* loves watching tv/films \+ exploring fan communities on the internet.
* wants to work with a small, mighty team of the best consumer builders in the industry.



  





 Thank you for taking time to learn about what we do!
 



 Henry
 



  





 🚀 1 \- About Watch Club
 



 Watch Club’s mission is to create friendships through great storytelling. We build a product where fans watch TV shows and talk to their friends/fans in 1 platform. Think of it as a platform that combines Netflix with Twitter/Reddit/Instagram/TikTok/IMDB/Letterboxd. 
 



  





 The opportunity:
 


* This is an exciting moment in the history of television and social networks!
* The way people discover, watch, and talk about TV is changing.
* People are spending less time watching television and spending more time watching narrative video on their smartphones.
* The microdrama industry is the fastest growing category in consumer video in the US, Europe, and China.
* We believe mobile TV is the future. We also believe mobile TV will be highly social.



  





 Our product:
 


* We are building a social video product where people watch and talk to each other about their favorite TV shows.
* Our prototype app is called WATCH CLUB.



  





 Our goal: By 2030, we build a community where 1 billion friends and fans watch and talk about mobile tv series everyday on our platform.
 



  





 Our product strategy:
 


* Distribute narrative stories that people love to watch and talk about
* Build elegant creative \& sharing tools for our fans to connect and talk with each other
* Celebrate people who contribute positively to the community
* We are a team of engineers and product people who’ve built 0\-1 products at Instagram, Facebook, Amazon, Airchat, Castro Labs, Alo, IDEO, and BeReal.
* We are writers and producers who’ve made talkworthy female\-led tv shows at Netflix, Amazon, and Hulu.
* Investors: GV (Google Ventures), Patreon CEO Jack Conte, and leaders from Meta, Hulu, HBO.



  





 Our content roadmap:
 


* We are producing 10 new short form shows
* Create a community of 5M young women and lgbtq\+ people who watch \+ talk to each other everyday
* Our shows are inspired by the unique format of the hugely popular Norwegian tv series SKAM



  





 🎨 2 \- What you’ll build at WATCH CLUB:
 


* World\-class video experience. Create useful and delightful products that help audiences to easily watch narrative stories on mobile. Elegant creative and sharing tools. Build elegant tools that help audiences talk, make memes, create fan edits, and connect with each other over the stories on the platform.
* Identity and community: We’re building a social network. People come for the show. And stay for the network. We are building a space where the fan discussion/community is as much fun as the show itself.



  





 ⚡️ 3 \- About You:
 



 Mission\-aligned:
 


* You’re excited about building the next generation of consumer social products.
* You love using social apps, from mainstream platforms to new, viral startups, and you think deeply about what makes products spread organically through user\-to\-user growth.



  





 Technical fluency:
 


* We're looking for someone who owns the mobile experience end\-to\-end — deep in native iOS, with the React chops to ship polished mobile web on their own — and whose work proves it.
* Native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) is the heart of the product and where you'll spend most of your time — and you'll also carry our mobile web experience in React, so fans meet the same craft whether they arrive through the App Store or a shared link. You'll partner closely with our lead engineer on the backend and contribute to our Node.js services yourself, so you're shaping the full stack and experience layer.



  





 What you'll own
 


* The iOS app. The player, the feed, the discovery, the social primitives — every screen a fan touches. Native Swift/SwiftUI, taken from sketch to shipped without a handoff. You'll have strong opinions about how a tap should feel and the room to act on them.
* The mobile web experience. Shared links are how a social product spreads. You'll build our React mobile web so a friend who taps a link feels the same craft as a friend who downloads the app — and so the web becomes a real surface, not just a download funnel.
* Full\-stack reach when the feature calls for it. Most features touch backend. You'll partner closely with our team on Node.js services, write the endpoints when it's faster, and care about the boundary between client and server.
* The patterns the team builds on. You're the second engineer. The iOS architecture, the component vocabulary, the event taxonomy — what you set up now compounds for everyone who joins after you.
* The roadmap, with me. What's worth building, what's not, what we're learning from users. You won't be implementing someone else's spec.
* Using AI tools well. We're heavy Claude users and want someone who can direct it productively and push back when it's wrong
* Caring about the audience. You don't have to be in the target demo, but you have to be genuinely curious about why people fall in love with shows and the communities around them



 💭 4 \- Soft Skills
 


* Low ego, high EQ: You’re self\-aware, open to feedback, and care deeply about doing what’s best for the product and team.
* Collaborative: You enjoy working cross\-functionally with design, engineering, and leadership. You like brainstorms, healthy debate, and navigating ambiguity together.
* Clear communicator: You can reason through complex trade\-offs and explain decisions simply to both technical and non\-technical partners.



  





 Because this is a small seed\-stage team, the candidate should show evidence of building from ambiguity, owning features without handoff, and making pragmatic product/engineering decisions. Strong preference for engineers with a DIY builder mentality: people who have independently built, launched, and iterated on their own apps/products, ideally shipped to the App Store or web and attempted to acquire real users.
 



  





 💻 5\. Work Style
 


* Goals\-focused: You set ambitious goals and work relentlessly to hit them.
* Problem\-first mindset: You fall in love with problems, not solutions. You’re comfortable throwing away ideas that aren’t working.
* Product\-driven: You care deeply about building great products, not just code quality. You’re excited to test ideas quickly and double down on what works.
* Independent and scrappy: You can get yourself unstuck, figure things out, and make progress even when things are ambiguous.
* Location: We are an in\-person team. You live in Los Angeles or are excited to move to LA.



  





 If you don’t meet every requirement but believe you’d be a great fit, please apply and tell us why.
 



  





 ☀️ 6\. Benefits and Support
 


* Competitive salary and equity compensation
* Flexible working hours and generous time off
* Comprehensive health benefits (Medical, Dental, Vision)
* WATCH CLUB works in\-office 5 days/week in Beverly Grove, Los Angeles
* Culture: we are a team of kind, smart, creative, and mission\-focused builders



  





 WATCH CLUB is committed to an inclusive and diverse workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by law. If you require accommodation during the application process, just let us know.

The PSE Director collaborates with sales and delivery resources to ensure proposed deals include technical solutions that accurately address customer needs and are appropriately supported by key customer technical decision\-makers. The PSE Director is responsible for achieving a productivity quota made up of the combined expectations of the sales resources, market, industry, and/or channel supported. The sales territory will encompass pursuits across the nation, and flexible work or partial work from home is acceptable, if preferred.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Works deals assigned to the sales team supported, prioritizing effort based on maximizing total impact on team productivity, or as directed by Practice Leaders or Sales Director
* Proactively scopes the technical solution required to address customer requirements, assesses customers met and unmet needs, and recommends solutions that optimize value for both the customer and the firm
* Secures input from all necessary solution stakeholders within the customer. Adapts solutions, as necessary, to ensure appropriate support
* Coordinates closely with internal sales and delivery resources to align solution design with customers’ business requirements
* Secures from customer technical staff commitments needed to ensure a deal’s “technical close.”
* Meets assigned targets for profitable sales growth in assigned product lines, market areas, channel, or teams supported
* Provides coaching and professional development to team member sales associates in order to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills
* Opportunistically pursues additional business development opportunities within clients. Collaborates with sales to ensure these opportunities are effectively covered and advanced
* Maintain strong relationships with channel team, partner technology specialists, and partner sales executives
* Keep up with product announcements and sales incentives and programs. Communicate important product changes to consulting and sales teams
* Assists in development of go\-to\-market and sales strategies


 Accountabilities \& Performance Measures
   

  

* Achieves assigned productivity quotas
* Maintains deal through\-put in early deal\-sales process steps
* Achieves product growth targets for the assigned geography, channel, sales team, or account base
* Maintains high customer satisfaction ratings that meet company standards
* Completes required training and development objectives within the assigned time frame


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s Degree
* Previous experience presenting data analytics/AI related software solutions (business\-to\-business) with a focus on middle market/strategic customer segment
* Previous presales presentation experience
* A record of achievement and technical solution expertise in a comparable sales role
* Product certification, engineering credential, or equivalent technical credential
* Experience leveraging a CRM tool for report generation and sales tracking
